subject: Pilot sizing & budget — proposed per-model rates and next steps
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia@stellarai.com>, James Li <jli@stellarai.com>
Cc: markus_klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-20T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Pilot sizing & budget — call recap + asks

Thanks for the time today — quick recap and proposed asks so we can size a short pilot. Notes from the call:
- Primary POC: Alicia (NLP product lead).
- Goal: Evaluate real-time chat & semantic search for desktop app; embeddings for search ranking.
- Target latency: <= 350ms 95p for chat inference.
- Compliance: SOC2 review in parallel; procurement will want an indemnity clause.

Quantities discussed (ballpark from your side):
- Chat requests: 700k messages/month (avg 75 tokens in prompt + 60 tokens output).
- Embeddings: 400k vectors/month (1536-d).
- Rerank/semantic scoring: 250k calls/month (short inputs).
- Budget range you mentioned: $8k–$20k/month initially (pilot + spike buffer).

Immediate asks from us to prepare a pilot proposal:
1) Confirm a realistic 90-day pilot budget target (range or fixed).
2) Confirm per-model usage split you expect during pilot (chat/embeddings/rerank in %).
3) Any internal SLA or security checklist items we should pre-send to your procurement team.

I'll follow up with a draft pricing worksheet and a proposed pilot scope document — attaching the initial worksheet and scope for reference.

Attachments: redwood_pricing_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), pilot_scope.pdf (pdf)

Thanks,
Hannah Schmitt

Hi Hannah — thanks for the recap, that's aligned with our notes. A few clarifications:
- The 700k chat messages is an upper bound; for the pilot we expect ~300k/month. Production would be the 700k+ range.
- For embeddings, 400k vectors/month is steady.
- Rerank calls are likely to be closer to 150k/month during pilot (but could spike).
- Pilot budget: Alicia (product) prefers we lock a hard cap of $12k/month for the 90-day pilot; procurement is open to a 3-month prepaid or monthly invoice.

I'll introduce procurement on the thread once we have a clear quote to review. Also, SOC2 evidence request: they need our encryption-at-rest statement and vendor SOC2 summary.

Best,
Alicia

Subject: Re: Pilot sizing & budget — call recap + asks

Appreciate the clarification, Alicia. Based on your pilot caps (300k chat / 400k embeddings / 150k rerank) and your $12k/month hard cap, here's an initial unit-econ proposal to meet the target: 

Proposed target: keep net cost <= $12k/month for the pilot. To do that we propose a blended target of ~$11.5k/month with the following per-1M-token effective rate for chat work (to make monthly math clear):
- Chat (gpt-like) blended target: $1,200 per 1M tokens (we'll provide a reduced pilot rate applied to usage so your $ cap holds).
- Embeddings: priced per vector; pilot rate $0.008 per vector (equivalent of $8 per 1k).
- Rerank/scoring: micro-billing at $0.003 per call.

Rough pilot math (month):
- Chat tokens: 300k messages * (75+60)=135 tokens avg -> 40.95M tokens -> at $1,200/1M = $49,140 (obviously this overshoots) — so we need to do either a pilot-only discount or a capped included token bucket.

Options to land at $12k: 
A) Fixed pilot package: include 40M chat tokens + 400k embeddings + 150k rerank for $12k/month. Overages billed at the pilot rates above.
B) Deeply discounted pilot rate on chat: $250 per 1M tokens for pilot only (first 90 days), embeddings $0.006/vector, rerank $0.002/call; still put a hard $12k cap.

I recommend Option A for predictability if procurement prefers a hard included bucket; Option B is cleaner if you want per-usage visibility.

Can procurement confirm preferred billing model (prepay vs monthly invoice) and whether an included bucket is acceptable?

Thanks — I'll loop Markus to confirm feasibility of the included bucket and whether we can compress infrastructure costs for a pilot to meet Option A.

Hannah
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Pilot sizing & budget — call recap + asks

On Sun, Nov 22, 2026 at 10:27 AM Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com> wrote:
> I recommend Option A for predictability if procurement prefers a hard included bucket; Option B is cleaner if you want per-usage visibility.

Quick technical note from infra side — we can support an included bucket for the pilot but need to be explicit about model choices that make the economics plausible. For the included 40M token bucket (example):
- Chat composition assumption: 60% of chat tokens served by a smaller, cheaper chat model (e.g., redwood-small/opt-6b-quant), 40% by a higher-quality chat model for longer-tail queries. That composition reduces cost without changing latency SLOs for the 95p.
- Embeddings: we can provide a pilot-quantized embedding runner that reduces per-vector cost ~25% while maintaining vector quality for ranking tests.
- Rerank: run as batch scoring where possible to reduce per-call overhead (saves ~30% on token-equivalent cost).

If StellarAI confirms Option A, we will produce a line-item pilot quote with included buckets and a short appendix listing model mapping and expected per-model token splits.

-Markus
Principal Systems Engineer, Redwood Inference
